evidence.detail: validate_pofile() calls pofile.read_po(f) with no exception handling; if Babel raises TranslationError (e.g. for an unknown named placeholder) the entire maintenance script crashes
ad_hoc() calls validate_pofile() without catching TranslationError, so the crash propagates and aborts the whole translation update run
validate_translations.ad_hoc() is called before compile_catalog; a crash here would prevent .mo files from being compiled

triage.fix_sketch: In maintenance/validate_translations.py, wrap the pofile.read_po(f) call in validate_pofile() with a try/except for babel.core.UnknownLocaleError and babel.messages.pofile.PoFileError (or the base Exception), printing the path and error and returning early. Additionally wrap the validate_pofile(path) call in ad_hoc() with a similar guard so one bad .po file does not abort processing of the remaining files. Changes are ~8-12 lines in maintenance/validate_translations.py.
triage.notes: The .po files are not stored in the repo (generated at runtime from POEditor via maintenance/update_translations.py); the underlying bad Japanese translation in POEditor at line 533 may also need fixing but that is out-of-band.
